name: apple-web-app
tagline_zh: 装完才发现刘海遮字、键盘顶输入框？它专查 Add to Home Screen 后的安全区、状态栏、主题色。
tagline_en: Stop shipping web apps that look broken once installed. It audits safe areas, status bar, theme color, icons &.
desc_en: Use when implementing, debugging, or auditing iPhone/iPad Add to Home Screen or macOS Safari Add to Dock web app UI: safe areas, status bar, theme colour, keyboard, manifest, icons, splash screens, or installed navigation. Not for service workers, offline caching, or push.
why_zh: 别人只测浏览器，它测的是「加到主屏幕后」那一层：安全区、键盘避让、manifest 与图标是否齐全。
why_en: Most tools stop at the browser tab. This one checks the installed layer—safe areas, keyboard insets, manifest, icons—where web.
limit_zh: 只管已安装 Web App 的界面与元数据；不做 Service Worker、离线缓存或推送。需要真机或模拟器验证。
limit_en: UI & metadata only for installed web apps. No service workers, offline caching, or push. Requires a real device or simulator—desktop preview won't.
title_en: Web app inspector for iPhone home screen & Mac Dock
